newsitem.title: USA: Arnold Palmer 7-mos to Sept 30 loss widens.
newsitem.headline: Arnold Palmer 7-mos to Sept 30 loss widens.

text.p: Arnold Palmer Golf Co said Tuesday that it posted a net loss of $2.3 million, $0.80 per share, for a seven-month transition period that ended September 30 compared to a net loss of $1.1 million, $0.42 per share, for the same period in the prior year.
The period included a $900,000 charge from a defaulted loan repayment from DeLong Sportswear, the company said.

The transition period was from March 3 through September 30, 1996. It is the result of a change in the end of the company's fiscal year from the Saturday closest to the end of the February to September 30.
The company's fiscal year will now run from October 1 to September 30, it said.
Net sales for the seven months ended Sept. 30 reached $18.5 million, a $3.7 million increase from $14.8 million in the same period in 1995, it said.
Arnold Palmer Golf Co manufactures, markets and distributes golf products.
